title: UK CPI, April 2027 (ONS, 07:00 London) — the print where the electricity-VAT drag drops out and a hot number is arithmetic, not re-acceleration
source: EST: ons.gov.uk release calendar, swept across all 37 pages of upcoming releases direct on 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200) — the entry reads 'Consumer price inflation, UK: April 2027 | Release date: 19 May 2027 7:00am | Provisional'. ONS's own label is Provisional, not Confirmed, which is the honest reason for `estimate` on top of the standing schema gap: market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy (IR:/CAL:/BLS:/FED:/PJM:/SEC:/TSY:/OCC:/BEA:/CENSUS:/ISM:/CB:/UMICH:/FHFA:) has no slot for ONS. Discovered in the never-assessed initial research of uk-electricity-vat-reversion-2027-04-01, 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED BY THE uk-electricity-vat-reversion-2027-04-01 LANE, 2026-09-09. This is the SCORING VENUE for that event and it is on the calendar for one reason: it is the first observation of the 0%-to-5% VAT reversion, and it will look like inflation news when it is arithmetic. TWO DISTINCT NUMBERS LAND IN THE SAME BULLETIN AND ARE EASY TO CONFLATE: (1) the CPI ELECTRICITY INDEX rises about +5.0% MONTH-ON-MONTH from VAT alone (restoring 5% VAT to a zero-rated price is +5/100, not the -5/105 = 4.7619% the cut took out); (2) HEADLINE year-on-year steps up only about +0.09 to +0.13pp versus the March 2027 print, as the drag drops out of the annual comparison. The headline band is wide because the 2027 CPI electricity weight is undrawn until the January 2027 index publishes 2027-02-17 -- ONS series CJXA has moved 27.0 (2023), 23.3142 (2024), 19.1488 (2025), 20.6065 (2026). THE ATTRIBUTION RULE THIS ENTRY EXISTS TO CARRY: a UK April 2027 CPI print running ~0.1pp hotter than a naive model is a TAX CHANGE, not re-acceleration and not a hawkish surprise -- check the ONS contributions table before it is read as one. CONFOUND: the Ofgem Apr-Jun 2027 cap resets on the same date (announced roughly late February 2027), so the month-on-month electricity move mixes VAT with the cap reset. SEQUENCING WORTH KEEPING: this print lands AFTER the 2027-04-29 MPC + Monetary Policy Report, which must forecast the reversion with no post-lapse data, and BEFORE the 2027-06-17 MPC, which is the first committee to see it. CONTINGENT ON THE LAPSE HAPPENING -- registered as FT-uk-electricity-vat-reversion-2027-04-01-1, score by 2027-03-31; if the zero rate is extended, this print's VAT step does not occur and the entry should be re-noted rather than dropped (the print itself still happens). Tiered LOW: symbols: [], no UK listing, gilt or sterling instrument on this calendar. Estimate widens caution only.
